purpose: Single macro source of truth; user projects, economic state and native app execution are independent

stable.ci: 19/19 offline + Chromium HUD PASS before merge

related_independent_systems: Railway/Supabase durable runtime and owner execution
limitations: A browser userscript cannot list all installed extensions or detect invisible userscripts.
DOM panel collision detection is partial; no universal cross-browser/runtime synchronization.
Version in source is not proof of installation; Tampermonkey updates are per browser/profile and depend on settings.
Native Android/iOS ChatGPT apps cannot be modified by the userscript.
An open ChatGPT tab is not a persistent background executor; no automatic execution after tab closure.
Parallel browser lanes require the corresponding ChatGPT project tabs to remain open; the userscript is not a cloud background runtime.
The page cannot enable or disable separate Tampermonkey scripts at extension level; v4.1 centralizes supported macro features as internal modules and blocks legacy collisions.
